name: manual_7f3f59
claim: Decision (operator-approved 2026-11-25): the OpenClaw gateway launch agent must never name a node version. A stable link (~/.local/share/openclaw-node) points at the single nvm node that satisfies the engines range (>=24.22.1 <25 or >=26.12.1) and carries the global openclaw version that AlphaClaw pins; the plist's ProgramArguments use the link. One owner, perpetua_tools.openclaw_runtime, with --check (read-only, exit 1 on drift) and --apply (repoint, rewrite, reload only on change). Rejected: reinstalling the service after every Node change (the step that gets forgotten), a second dedicated node (breaks the one-24.x rule and doubles patching), and an auto-repointing watcher (it could move the gateway onto a half-migrated node, so the watcher alerts only).

decisions.notes: A plist that stored the exact nvm version folder left a KeepAlive service crash-looping when that node was removed; the new service file carried the version twice (node binary and openclaw entry).

rationale: A plist that stored the exact nvm version folder left a KeepAlive service crash-looping when that node was removed; the new service file carried the version twice (node binary and openclaw entry).
